acceptanceCriteria: A frozen retrieval corpus keeps real commit history per sample, with its provenance and licence recorded, so recency features are not 1 everywhere.
The CORVINT_CONTEXT_RECENCY off/on arms are rerun on it and decision 0369's opt-in status is revisited from that reading.
Only then is git recency evaluated as a fused channel alongside V1-0219's ordering.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 when V1-0219 was rescoped to RRF vs corroboration. Decision 0369 keeps CORVINT_CONTEXT_RECENCY opt-in because the frozen agent_retrieval_bench rebuilds each snapshot as one commit, so every ranked list was identical off and on (BUILD-LOG 2026-09-23, V1-0089). Fusing recency as a channel is unmeasurable until a corpus keeps history.
title: eval: build a history-preserving retrieval corpus so git recency can be measured and fused
